tool_input.command: pwd && echo "---ENV---" && env | grep -E "GCP_|MLPAB|GOOGLE" | sed 's/=.*/=***/' && echo "---DATA---" && ls -la data/ && echo "---HEAD---" && head -5 data/features.csv && echo "---WC---" && wc -l data/features.csv
cat data/schema.md && echo "---" && cut -d, -f2 data/features.csv | tail -n +2 | cut -dT -f1 | sort -u | head -50

cut -d, -f2 data/features.csv | tail -n +2 | cut -dT -f1 | sort -u | wc -l && echo "---first/last---" && cut -d, -f2 data/features.csv | tail -n +2 | cut -dT -f1 | sort -u | tail -3 && echo "---rows per day sample---" && cut -d, -f2 data/features.csv | tail -n +2 | cut -dT -f1 | sort | uniq -c | head -3
tool_input.description: Count days and rows per day

tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
import os
from google.cloud import bigquery
proj=os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']; ds=os.environ['GCP_BQ_DATASET']; loc=os.environ['GCP_LOCATION']
print('project',proj); print('dataset',ds); print('location',loc); print('prefix',os.environ['MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX'])
c=bigquery.Client(project=proj)
d=c.get_dataset(ds)
print('dataset location', d.location)
print('tables:', [t.table_id for t in c.list_tables(ds)])
"

cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
import os
from google.cloud import bigquery
proj=os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']; ds=os.environ['GCP_BQ_DATASET']
c=bigquery.Client(project=proj)
table_id=f'{proj}.{ds}.features'
schema=[
 bigquery.SchemaField('entity_id','STRING'),
 bigquery.SchemaField('event_time','TIMESTAMP'),
 bigquery.SchemaField('f1','FLOAT'),
 bigquery.SchemaField('f2','FLOAT'),
 bigquery.SchemaField('f3','FLOAT'),
 bigquery.SchemaField('f4','FLOAT'),
 bigquery.SchemaField('f5','FLOAT'),
 bigquery.SchemaField('f6','FLOAT'),
]
job_config=bigquery.LoadJobConfig(schema=schema, skip_leading_rows=1, source_format=bigquery.SourceFormat.CSV, write_disposition='WRITE_TRUNCATE')
with open('data/features.csv','rb') as f:
    job=c.load_table_from_file(f, table_id, job_config=job_config)
job.result()
t=c.get_table(table_id)
print('loaded rows', t.num_rows)
"

cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
import os
from google.cloud import bigquery
proj=os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']; ds=os.environ['GCP_BQ_DATASET']
c=bigquery.Client(project=proj)
q=f'''
SELECT DATE(event_time) AS d,
 AVG(f1) f1m, STDDEV(f1) f1s,
 AVG(f2) f2m, STDDEV(f2) f2s,
 AVG(f3) f3m, STDDEV(f3) f3s,
 AVG(f4) f4m, STDDEV(f4) f4s,
 AVG(f5) f5m, STDDEV(f5) f5s,
 AVG(f6) f6m, STDDEV(f6) f6s
FROM \`{proj}.{ds}.features\`
GROUP BY d ORDER BY d
'''
rows=list(c.query(q).result())
print('day', 'f1m','f2m','f3m','f4m','f5m','f6m')
for r in rows:
    print(r.d, f'{r.f1m:.2f} {r.f2m:.2f} {r.f3m:.2f} {r.f4m:.2f} {r.f5m:.2f} {r.f6m:.2f}')
"

cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
import os
from google.cloud import bigquery
proj=os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']; ds=os.environ['GCP_BQ_DATASET']
c=bigquery.Client(project=proj)
# Confirm f2 step: min f2m after onset vs max before
q=f'''
WITH daily AS (
 SELECT DATE(event_time) d, AVG(f2) m FROM \`{proj}.{ds}.features\` GROUP BY d
)
SELECT
 MAX(IF(d < DATE(\"2026-02-22\"), m, NULL)) AS max_before,
 MIN(IF(d >= DATE(\"2026-02-22\"), m, NULL)) AS min_after
FROM daily
'''
r=list(c.query(q).result())[0]
print('max f2 mean before 02-22:', round(r.max_before,3))
print('min f2 mean on/after 02-22:', round(r.min_after,3))
"
